title: Remove the actions menu from the pull request list, together with its step editor
summary: Removed the per-row actions menu from the Git panel's pull request list, its full-screen step editor, the pull request part of the launch command and the record writer, and the graph library only the editor used; the list, filters and detail are unchanged. The owner must try the change, then merge pull request #703.
lessons_learned: A dev build (npm run tauri dev) shares the installed Maestro's app-data folder: it showed the installed app's crash-recovery dialog, where a wrong click would have cleared the user's saved terminal list. Agents taking a dev-build screenshot must dismiss nothing in that dialog, or use an isolated data folder.
The person asked mid-run for light reviewers (sonnet, low effort); the opus confirming review was stopped unposted and replaced, so review-692-r2 appears twice.
